title: Prescribed
description: Definition of Prescribed under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: prescribed by rules made by the Central Government, or, as the case may be, the State Government;
content.plain_language: officially stated or required by rules made by the Central or State Government
examples: A company must follow the prescribed procedure for consumer complaints.
The government has prescribed rules for e-commerce platforms to protect consumer rights.
non_examples: A company's internal policy is not considered prescribed unless mandated by the government.
A general guideline that is not enforced by law is not prescribed.
